_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Music history, releases, charts, and playable OffStereo follow-ups.

description: Call exactly once for a 'today in music' or dated music-history request. One response already combines album anniversaries, artist birthdays and memorials, current releases, current US song-chart context, and related playable OffStereo stories; use that one combined call rather than separate history, releases, charts, or shows calls. dateMode=today uses the listener's current day and omits date; dateMode=explicit pairs with a named YYYY-MM-DD date. limit is the maximum total across the combined response, playableOnly limits rows to music that plays in ChatGPT, and allowBuild=false plus allowSave=false preserves a read-only request. This is the only dated-music tool in the current schema.

allowBuild.description: False preserves an explicit request not to create or build a story.

allowSave.description: False preserves an explicit request not to create or save anything.

date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD for dateMode=explicit; absent for dateMode=today.

dateMode.description: today represents the listener's current day; explicit represents one named calendar date.

limit.description: Maximum total results across the already-combined response (1-20, default 8). Honor an explicit result count.

playableOnly.description: True limits music-history results to rows with audio playable in ChatGPT.

name: music_today

outputSchema.description: A discovery card. object is 'discovery' (new releases or music-today) or 'show_search' (archive/popular). Which section arrays are populated depends on the mode.

title: Music today
